Subject: Post-call: Recap + Mutual Action Plan (MAP) — Redwood + FintechX

Samir / Aisha — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed MAP based on our discussion: 

Summary:
- Current: In-house CPU-based endpoints with occasional GPU experiments; peak traffic ~3k qps/day with big spikes during batch settlement windows.
- Goals: p95 latency target 75ms for scoring, lower tokenized-model costs, and a path to private/dedicated production deployment for compliance.

Proposed MAP:
- Phase 0 (Discovery & Baseline) — Week 1–2\  Owner: FintechX / Camila\  Actions: share infra diagram + sample traffic (Samir); Redwood runs a lightweight baseline with sample payloads on hosted test account (Camila)
- Phase 1 (Pilot — Hosted -> Dedicated) — Week 3–6\  Owner: Redwood / FintechX\  Actions: pilot on dedicated reserved capacity; tune batching/quant profiles; validate p95 latency in staging
- Phase 2 (Prod roll & Compliance) — Week 7–10\  Owner: FintechX\  Actions: security review (Aisha) completes, private deployment if needed, finalize SLOs and runbook

Attachments: FintechX_MAP_v1.pdf (map with timeline & owners), Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (again for reference)

Requested next items from your side:
1) Shared infra diagram + 24h sample traffic (Samir) — target: Tue 11/2
2) Any specific compliance constraints to flag early (Aisha)

If the timeline looks off, happy to adjust — but once we have the infra/sample data we'll share a quantified latency/cost estimate and propose pilot sizing.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Senior Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
